messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The customer lacks clear information on how tiered pricing impacts their claims volume.
  quote: We’re reviewing our annual spend with Keelwater and need clarity on how tiered pricing affects our claims volume this year... can you send me a breakdown of how your pricing tiers apply to our monthly claims volume?
- problem: The customer is unsure if the tiered pricing works for their fluctuating claim volume and worries they may be stuck with the current payment integration.
  quote: We’re evaluating whether the tiered pricing model fits our claims volume, especially with seasonal spikes... are we locked into the current payment integration?
